title: File:"Old Diver's" Headstone.jpg
description: This monument is near the British Cemetery on Ocracoke Island, in the outer banks of North Carolina. It is dedicated to Augustus Abner McGuire. who is remembered in local folklore as "Old Diver." He died in an offshore diving accident in September of 1913 and was buried in a now unmarked grave. This marker is not situated exactly on his grave site. According to local legend, his ghost is sometimes seen wandering in the area in full early-20th century diving gear, to include a large diving helmet
